mapping_evidence: Official nine-class schema: 1/2 serves; 3 clear; 4 drive; 5 smash; 6 net; 7 drop; 8 lift; 9 combined push/kill retained as other. Backhand 1=backhand, 2=not backhand. No half-smash target.
frame_convention: HitFrame is a published contact ordinal; universal zero/one base remains undocumented. Do not convert with declared 30 FPS without source review.
split_policy: Published train/val are clip partitions; original match IDs and overlap with existing corpora require an independent audit. Normalized split remains unassigned.
media_policy: Media hashes establish file identity, not decoded clock or contact adjudication. No video extraction, model inference or app annotation writes during import.
